name: Individual counselling
description: A one to one session with an LGBTIQ+ affirming counsellor. Talk about whatever you need to, at your pace.
location: Room 2, ground floor, Fitzroy, or a telehealth link

name: Peer navigation
description: Half an hour with a peer worker who has been through the system, to help you find the right service and prepare for the first appointment.
location: Telehealth link, sent with your reminder

name: Trans and gender diverse peer group
description: A facilitated group for trans and gender diverse people. Come as often or as rarely as you like, no need to speak.
location: Community room, ground floor, Fitzroy. Step free access.

name: Over 50s connection group
description: A relaxed group for LGBTIQ+ people over 50, including people living with HIV. Tea, conversation, and a guest speaker once a month.
location: Community room, ground floor, Fitzroy, or a telehealth link
